headlines.title: Costco closes popular California store location after 37 years
headlines.summary: The warehouse retailer opens a new 152,000 square-foot Costco location 1 mile from the store it closed.

headlines.title: A Fund With $4.5 Billion in US Equities Dumps These 3 Stocks
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysAlphinity Investment Management sold all of its Costco, American Express and Intuitive Surgical shares in the third quarter, its latest 13F shows. The Costco exit looks smartest: the stock trades at 46x forward earnings with 3% left to analysts’ average target.

headlines.title: Costco’s longtime shoppers may not love what comes next
headlines.summary: The warehouse club has been quietly making changes to serve its changing customer base.

headlines.title: Costco (COST) Brings Real Time Health Benefit Checkout To More Than 600 Warehouses
headlines.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) is now integrated with NationsBenefits' Flex Card across more than 600 U.S. warehouses. The rollout lets eligible health plan members redeem over the counter, healthy food, and wellness benefits directly at Costco checkout. NationsBenefits' Flex Card processes these health related purchases in real time, reducing manual reimbursement steps for members.

headlines.title: Costco's October Net Sales Jump 12.6% as Digital Growth Accelerates
headlines.summary: Costco's October sales surge 12.6%, fueled by strong comparable sales and digital growth, but its premium valuation and earnings revisions raise concerns.

description: Costco Wholesale Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of membership warehouses in the United States, Puerto Rico, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the United Kingdom, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, China, Spain, France, Sweden, Iceland, and New Zealand. It offers merchandise, including sundries, dry groceries, candies, coolers, freezers, liquor, and tobacco; non-food merchandise comprising consumer electronics, appliances, small electrics, health and beauty aids, hardware, lawn and garden, sporting goods, tires, toys and seasonal, automotive, stamps, tickets, apparel, furniture, domestics, housewares, special order kiosks, and jewelry; and fresh food, such as meat, produce, deli, and bakery products. The company is also involved in warehouse ancillary operations, which include gasoline, pharmacies, food courts, optical, hearing aids, and tire installation centers. In addition, it engages in e-commerce, business centers, travel, and other businesses. Further, the company operates e-commerce sites; and offers branded and private-label products in various categories. The company was formerly known as Costco Companies, Inc. and changed its name to Costco Wholesale Corporation in August 1999. Costco Wholesale Corporation was founded in 1976 and is based in Issaquah, Washington.
